Two r/StableDiffusion threads (scraped via in-page .json API after HTML rate-limit; saved to scratch/reddit_h3_two.json). (1) obvpm 'Mini Video Editor Timeline Node for H3' (110 pts, github chanon/comfyui-obvpm-timeline, built on NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context): Extend/Prepend/BRIDGE/Cut/Loop/Upscale. Bridge = extend from END latents of one clip + prepend onto START latents of another, so image AND motion are continuous at the seam; frame anchoring (FNI FL2VA) constrains images only. Bridge also resets long-chain drift: generate a later clip fresh, then bridge the clip in between. Extend-from-cut = trim a bad tail and extend from the good part = cheap partial retake. Writes all conditioning to .cond.safetensors (encoded prompt + encoded ref latents) beside each low-res clip, so a whole sequence can be latent-upscaled LATER without re-entering prompts/refs — implication: the 494 chunks could be upscaled at the end instead of re-rendered. Ops confirm it does NOT re-render pixels; it upscales saved latents + original conditioning. (2) Suibeam 'best way to use H3 ref2video': DRAW a crude composition instead of sourcing photoreal refs — cruder is better for pose because H3 latches onto shapes in detailed refs; physically incompatible refs deform the result (bun-invisible-from-front example) — fix by describing the feature as it appears from that angle, not by repeating the pose. Both folded into fni-h3-pipeline skill (new sections: chaining/bridging, sketch refs). Both repos cloned to explore/ (obvpm-timeline 3.0MB, h3-motion-context 628KB); obvpm exposes H3Timeline/H3JointRender/H3JointLatent/H3Assemble/H3Save+LoadMCtx etc., NikoDemon80 exposes MiniMaxH3MotionContext{,Trim,SaveLatent,LoadLatent,Chain}.

5090 access constraint (blocks node installs): ComfyUI is reachable over HTTP via Tailscale (100.104.7.72:8188, version 0.38.0) but the BOX's filesystem is not — port 22 refused (no SSH), and ComfyUI-Manager is NOT installed (all /api/manager/* and /customnode/* endpoints 404), so custom_nodes cannot be populated remotely. Previously unnecessary because all work went through /prompt + /view. To install the obvpm-timeline + h3-motion-context node packs: tools/install_5090_nodes.sh (run ON the box; deps verified trivial — torch/numpy/aiohttp + comfy internals only, so it is clone + restart, no pip step), then restart ComfyUI. Latent upscaling (not chaining) additionally wants minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors in models/latent_upscale_models/. Next step once nodes register: A/B anchoring (FL2VA frame) vs bridging (motion context) on the S02 glacier chains, same chunks/seed, side-by-side like the T0009 comparison.
